situations.title: 흉부외상 호흡 사정
situations.tagline: It really hurts to take a deep breath since the crash.
situations.brief: 흉부 둔상 환자의 양측 호흡음·흉벽 대칭·통증을 체계적으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to listen to your breathing on both sides.
Point to where it hurts the most when you breathe in.
Take a slow, deep breath for me if you can.
goals: 흡기 시 통증 부위와 강도를 확인한다

situations.title: 복부외상 초기 사정
situations.tagline: My belly is really sore where the seatbelt was.
situations.brief: 복부 둔상 환자의 압통·팽만·안전벨트 자국을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to gently press on your belly in a few spots.
Tell me if any area is tender or feels hard.
Can I see where the seatbelt crossed your body?
goals: 안전벨트 자국 등 표재 손상 단서를 확인한다

situations.title: 활력·쇼크 징후 감시
situations.tagline: I feel dizzy and my heart is pounding really fast.
situations.brief: 외상 환자의 빈맥·저혈압 등 내부출혈성 쇼크 초기 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your blood pressure and heart rate closely.
Do you feel lightheaded or like you might pass out?
Your skin looks pale, so we're watching you carefully.
goals: 빈맥·저혈압·창백 등 쇼크 초기 징후를 사정한다

situations.title: 통증 척도·부위 청취
situations.tagline: The pain gets much worse when I breathe in deep.
situations.brief: 흡기 시 악화되는 흉복부 통증의 척도와 부위를 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain now?
Does the pain get worse when you breathe in?
Show me exactly where it hurts with one finger.
goals: 흡기 연관 통증 부위와 양상을 파악한다

situations.title: 수상기전(MOI) 확보
situations.tagline: The car hit us on my side and the airbags went off.
situations.brief: 충돌·핸들·안전벨트 등 수상기전 정보를 정확히 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me how the accident happened?
Were you wearing a seatbelt and did the airbag deploy?
Did your chest or belly hit the wheel or dashboard?

situations.title: 늑골 다발골절 호흡저하
situations.tagline: It hurts so much I can barely breathe in.
situations.brief: 늑골 다발골절로 통증성 저환기가 있는 환자의 진통과 호흡을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The rib fractures make breathing painful, so we'll manage the pain.
Try to take slow deep breaths even though it hurts.
Good pain control will help you breathe more fully.
goals: 통증으로 인한 저환기와 SpO2 저하를 사정한다

situations.title: 폐좌상 지연성 악화
situations.tagline: I felt fine at first but now I can't catch my breath.
situations.brief: 폐좌상으로 시간 경과 후 SpO2가 떨어지는 환자를 재사정·보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Your oxygen level has dropped since you arrived.
A bruised lung can get worse over the next few hours.
We're going to give you oxygen and watch you closely.
goals: 지연성 SpO2 저하와 호흡곤란 진행을 인지한다

situations.title: 비장손상 의심 좌상복부
situations.tagline: My left shoulder hurts and my upper belly is really sore.
situations.brief: 좌상복부 압통·Kehr 징후·저혈압으로 비장손상을 의심하고 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Does the pain spread up to your left shoulder?
I'm pressing on your upper left belly—tell me if it's tender.
We're checking for internal bleeding, so stay with me.

situations.title: 간손상 의심 우상복부
situations.tagline: The pain on my right side under the ribs keeps getting worse.
situations.brief: 우상복부 압통과 활력 추세로 간손상을 의심하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to feel under your right rib cage.
Your blood pressure is trending down, so we'll watch closely.
Tell me right away if you feel faint or more pain.
goals: 활력 추세로 간출혈 진행 위험을 판단한다

situations.title: 안전벨트 증후군
situations.tagline: There's a bruise line across my belly from the seatbelt.
situations.brief: 복벽 안전벨트 자국과 함께 지연성 장손상 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: That seatbelt mark tells us to check for deeper injury.
Bowel injuries can show up hours later, so we'll observe you.
Let me know if your belly pain spreads or gets worse.
goals: 복벽 자국과 연관된 심부 손상 위험을 사정한다

situations.title: 항응고제 흉복부 둔상
situations.tagline: I take a blood thinner—should I be worried about this bruise?
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용 둔상 환자의 출혈 확대 위험을 사정·관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: Because you take a blood thinner, bleeding can spread more easily.
Which blood thinner do you take and when was your last dose?
We'll watch you longer and repeat your labs to be safe.

situations.title: 관통성 복부 자상
situations.tagline: The knife is still in there—please don't pull it out!
situations.brief: 관통성 복부 자상에서 장기 탈출부는 습윤 피복하고 이물은 제거하지 마세요.
keyPhrases: We will not remove the object—we'll stabilize it in place.
I'm covering the wound with a moist sterile dressing.
Try to stay still so we don't make the injury worse.
goals: 탈출 장기를 습윤 멸균 피복으로 보호한다

situations.title: 임신부 복부외상
situations.tagline: I'm 30 weeks pregnant and my belly got hit in the crash.
situations.brief: 임신부 복부외상에서 태반조기박리 징후와 태아를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: How many weeks pregnant are you, and is the baby moving?
Are you having any bleeding, cramping, or tightening?
We'll put a monitor on to check the baby's heartbeat.

situations.title: 언어장벽 흉복부외상
situations.tagline: Dolor... aquí... no entiendo bien inglés.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자의 통증·기왕력을 통역과 함께 신속히 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm getting an interpreter so we understand each other.
Point to where it hurts and hold up fingers for how bad.
Do you have any medical problems or take any medicines?
goals: 통역 자원을 확보해 통증 부위를 파악한다

situations.title: 흉관 삽입 준비 설명
situations.tagline: What is that tube for and will it hurt a lot?
situations.brief: 혈흉/기흉 배액을 위한 흉관 삽입 목적과 절차를 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The tube drains air or blood so your lung can expand.
We'll numb the area first to make it more comfortable.
You'll feel pressure, but tell me if the pain is too much.
goals: 흉관의 목적과 절차를 이해하기 쉽게 설명한다

situations.title: 긴장성 기흉 감압 위기
situations.tagline: I can't breathe—my chest feels like it's caving in!
situations.brief: 호흡음 소실·기관 편위를 인지하고 즉시 바늘 감압을 준비·보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Your lung is collapsing and we need to act right now.
I'm getting the team to release the pressure in your chest.
Try to stay still—this will help you breathe in a moment.
goals: 호흡음 소실·경정맥 팽대 등 위기 징후를 즉시 인지한다

situations.title: 대량 혈흉 순환붕괴
situations.tagline: There's so much blood coming out of that tube...
situations.brief: 흉관 배액 급증과 순환붕괴에 대해 수혈·수술 준비를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: You're losing a lot of blood, so we're giving you a transfusion.
The surgical team is on the way to stop the bleeding.
We're watching your drainage and pressure every minute.

situations.title: 심장탐포네이드 Beck 삼징후
situations.tagline: My heart feels like it's being squeezed and I'm so weak.
situations.brief: 저혈압·경정맥 팽대·심음 감소의 Beck 삼징후를 인지·보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Your neck veins are full and your pressure is very low.
Fluid around your heart may be limiting its pumping.
We're preparing to relieve the pressure around your heart.

situations.title: 복강내 대량출혈 쇼크
situations.tagline: My belly is swelling up and I feel like I'm fading.
situations.brief: 복부 팽만·쇼크 환자의 개복 수술 이송을 신속히 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Your belly is filling with blood and your pressure is dropping.
You need surgery right away to stop the bleeding.
We're giving you blood and moving you to the OR now.

situations.title: 연가양 흉부(flail chest)
situations.tagline: Part of my chest moves the wrong way when I breathe.
situations.brief: 역설호흡을 보이는 연가양 흉부 환자의 환기 지원을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: A section of your ribs is moving separately when you breathe.
We'll support your breathing and control your pain.
You may need help from a ventilator to breathe well.

situations.title: 흉복부외상 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: The trauma surgeon is here—can you give me the report?
situations.brief: 손상 부위·배액량·활력을 SBAR 형식으로 정확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a 40-year-old with blunt chest and abdominal trauma.
Chest tube output is 400 milliliters and rising.
Blood pressure is dropping despite two units of blood.
